about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Business Engineer with technical depth
about.bio1: I'm a Business Engineer (Ingeniero Comercial) from Chile, based in Prague. Since 2018 I've worked across the whole product spectrum: enterprise B2B sales at Huawei, product management at Desafío Latam and full stack development at Czech Group.
about.bio2: Today I work as an independent IT consultant: I design and run cloud infrastructure, build web platforms and help businesses turn goals into products that ship. What I bring is the combination — I can talk numbers with the business and architecture with the engineers.
